observation.visible_scene: An outdoor lawn setting. On the left a staircase-like ramp is built from stacked brown cardboard boxes on light wooden blocks. On the right sit an upside-down metal pot with a wire handle, a bright pink plastic lid, a metal bowl, and a pale wooden tray; a yellow sack and a post are in the background. A small shiny blue marble is the moving subject.
visible_changes: The blue marble begins on an upper step (frame 1) and rolls steadily down the cardboard steps, reaching the flat top of the lowest box around frame 23.
It then rolls across the flat box top toward the pot (frames 24-31) and ends up on the pot's lid (frame 32).
On the lid the marble continues moving to the right, crossing the lid from left to center-right (frames 32-41).
From frame 35 a second, darker spherical object becomes visible at the very top of the staircase and descends the steps through frame 41, while the blue marble is already on the pot.

The background objects (pot, pink lid, bowl, tray, sack) and the box structure remain fixed in the frame, indicating the camera is essentially stationary; the apparent color shifts on the marble (greenish glints in some frames) are surface reflections, not separate objects.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the blue marble was released or set in motion before frame 1.
The final resting position or fate of either marble after frame 41.
Whether the dark object at the top is a second marble deliberately placed or another feature.
uncertain_details: The exact moment and cause of the dark top object's appearance (first clearly seen at frame 35).
Whether the slight positional jitter of the marble between consecutive frames reflects true motion or sub-pixel camera/handheld variation.
